text:
laura: opened a small docs PR to clarify KMS/HSM notes for Private installs on edge networks. PR here: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2683. Changes: add nftables example, clarify SNAT/masquerade implications, include a Go SDK snippet for private endpoints, and fix a moved anchor to the offline bundle page. Need quick review from @mike and @nina.

mike: Thanks — can you paste the nftables rule we should include? I want to sanity-check the port set examples for HSM traffic.

laura: pasted the minimal nftables block in the PR. Copying here for review:

```bash
# allow HSM management and PKCS11 ports on sealed site
nft add table ip redwood
nft add chain ip redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; }
nft add rule ip redwood input tcp dport {2222,33000-33010} accept
```

laura: Also added a note: "If kube-proxy is in iptables mode without masquerade, clients from sealed networks may require SNAT at the gateway to reach HSM appliances on legacy networks."

nina: LGTM on nftables example. A few small asks: 1) add a Windows PKCS11 provider example (some customers run HSM proxies on Windows gateways); 2) call out that some HSM appliances renumber slots after firmware upgrades.

laura: Added both. Windows sample config in the PR is: 

```ini
# kms-pkcs11.conf (Windows illustrative)
provider = C:\\Program Files\\HSM\\pkcs11.dll
slot = 1
pin = ${HSM_PIN}
```

laura: Included a short security callout: do not check actual PINs into repo; use env vars or secret stores.

mike: Also include a small Go SDK snippet showing TLS verify pointing to private CA and a basic backoff. Many internal examples only show Python. Suggestion: 

```go
// minimal private endpoint request
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "net/http"
  "time"
)
func main() {
  client := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://10.2.3.4:8443/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"prompt":"hi"}`)))
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
  // ensure TLS uses private CA bundle; docs note: configure Transport.TLSClientConfig.RootCAs
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  _ = resp; _ = err
}
```

nina: Nice. One link fix: docs-bot flagged that /install/offline-bundle anchor moved — replace with /install/airgap/bundle-verify.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: PR #2683 -> 1 moved anchor detected: /install/offline-bundle -> /install/airgap/bundle-verify. Suggested replacement applied in branch. Labels: doc:link-fix.

ops-bot: Infra note: QA saw intermittent failures when HSMs were behind a NAT with hairpin disabled. Added a troubleshooting bullet: "Enable hairpin/nat reflection on gateway or ensure gateway SNATs outbound to HSM subnets."

mike: tiny nit: prefer forward-slash paths in prose examples and include literal Windows escapes in code blocks for copy/paste. Otherwise LGTM.

laura: Pushed the Windows escaped example and updated prose. I'll merge on green and add a changelog entry. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
